# Final Seed Sitemap Write Plan

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos reveals the public gate in a swift and truthful stream;
Awtsmoos.com lets HTML links carry depth, while sitemaps seed the crawler's dream.

## Final implementation boundary

Rewrite completely:

- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/routes.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/publicHeichels.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/xml.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/createRoutes.js`
- `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/mimes.js`

Delete completely:

- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/heichelGraph.js`

Keep unchanged:

- `geelooy/robots.txt`
- `geelooy/sitemap.xml`
- all proven Road SSR files;
- all proven Heichel semantic-discovery files.

## Behavioral result

- `/heichelos/sitemap.xml` returns an XML URL set of every canonical public/discoverable Heichel root.
- No `/:heichel/sitemap.xml` route remains.
- No recursive graph code remains capable of monopolizing the server.
- `robots.txt` continues advertising the core root sitemap and the Heichel seed sitemap.
- `.txt` files serve as UTF-8 text/plain.
- `.xml` files serve as UTF-8 application/xml.

## Verification before exposure

Fresh process only. Require fast root/Heichel sitemap responses, correct MIME, Road SSR, Heichel hierarchy links, and no route regression. Only then expose that verified process through a real public preview URL and verify the public URL from outside the localhost boundary.
